get_state_dict: get the model and optimizer state dicts with canonical FQNs for FSDP or DDP parallelized models
get_model_state_dict: get the model state dict with full_state_dict and cpu_offload options for distributed checkpoints
get_optimizer_state_dict: get the combined optimizer state dicts with canonical FQN keys instead of parameter IDs
set_state_dict: load model and optimizer state dicts with canonical FQNs into a distributed parallelized model
patch_model_state_dict: patch model state_dict and load_state_dict methods to use canonical FQN state dict APIs
